name: button-no-label
description: <button> elements with neither `aria-label` nor `aria-labelledby`. The body parser cannot reliably tell whether children render visible text (children may be a JSX expression resolving to text at runtime), so this preset surfaces every button without an explicit accessible name. Pair with manual review or a project allow-list overlay for buttons with known-text children.

filter.reason: <button> needs aria-label / aria-labelledby OR visible text children. Review.
